text: The purpose of this report is to provide information on the merits of proxy voting and on options to strengthen Council's Pregnancy and Parental Leave Policy, both requested by the Executive Committee.

City Council on April 7 and 8, 2021, adopted the following: 1. City Council amend the Pregnancy and Parental Leave Policy for Members of Council to: a. provide that if a Member does not intend to attend any committee or board meetings during the leave, Council may take steps to fill the Member's vacancies on committees and boards on a temporary basis during the leave, subject to the Member resuming their seat at the end of the leave; and b. authorize the use of the Council staff replacement budget to pay for one additional staff Member for the duration of the leave.
